event.title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña Impeached and Arrested Amid Banking Crisis
event.canonical_title: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña Impeached and Arrested Amid Banking Crisis
event.summary: Santiago Peña has been impeached and placed under house arrest following a banking crisis that left nearly three million customers unable to access their funds. The Senate voted unanimously for his removal over allegations related to the collapse of Ueno Bank. Pedro Alliana has been sworn in as the new president, pledging to compensate those affected by the crisis.

timeline.title: Paraguay's former president faces charges over Ueno Bank collapse
timeline.summary: Santiago Peña, Paraguay's ousted president, has been charged with crimes related to the collapse of Ueno Bank, which left millions unable to access their funds. Prosecutors have ordered his arrest alongside former Central Bank chief Carlos Carvallo for alleged breach of trust and other offenses. Peña, who initially faced house arrest, has been moved to a military facility for safety amid ongoing protests from affected customers demanding access to their money.
key_facts: Santiago Peña charged with crimes linked to Ueno Bank's collapse.
Former Central Bank chief Carlos Carvallo also charged.
Millions of customers were locked out of their accounts.
